title: My Mall World Has Gifts I Can't Scale
content: In my own dreams I end up in a mall scenario, always with a GIANT pile of green and red Christmas gifts, to the point where I can't climb up them I can't go around I'm stuck. I always feel hopeless, and I never see anyone there. I'm alone, and petrified. I don't think I've ever been able to properly get over/around them, and there's always an aura of terror. It's never comfortable and if I have the dream I wake up and can't go back to sleep until I've calmed down. Is this like anyone else's'?
